```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(wordcloud)
```

```{r}
review_data <- read_csv("../../data/clean/primarycleaned_reviews_data.csv")
```

```{r}
data("stop_words")
other_stop_words <- tibble(
  word = c("book", "page", "pages", "read","books","story")
)
all_stop_words <- bind_rows(stop_words, other_stop_words) %>%
  distinct()
```


```{r}
review_data <- review_data %>%
  mutate(stars= as.character(round(as.numeric(stars))))%>%
  na.omit(stars)
unique_ratings <- review_data %>%
  distinct(stars) %>%
  pull(stars) %>%
  sort()
```

```{r}
for (current_rating in unique_ratings) {

  cat("Processing rating:", current_rating, "\n") 
  rating_specific_data <- review_data %>%
    filter(stars == current_rating)

  rating_words <- rating_specific_data %>%
    unnest_tokens(word, review_text) %>%
    anti_join(all_stop_words, by = "word") %>%
    filter(!str_detect(word, "^\\d+$")) %>%
    count(word, sort = TRUE)


  cat("  Generating word cloud for rating", current_rating, "...\n")
  set.seed(123) 

  num_colors <- min(8, nrow(rating_words)) 
  if(num_colors < 3) num_colors <- 3 
  word_colors <- brewer.pal(num_colors, "Dark2")

  wordcloud(
    words = rating_words$word,        
    freq = rating_words$n,            
    min.freq = 8,
    max.words = 150,                  
    random.order = TRUE,             
    rot.per = 0.30,                   
    colors = word_colors,
    scale = c(3, 0.2)
  )

  title(main = paste("Word Cloud for", current_rating, "Star Reviews"))

} 
```
